notes.title: Progress Report
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,
I wanted to give you a quick update about what's been going on with me. After the last update, I went through a bit of a rough time. I had trouble focusing, felt pretty exhausted, and most importantly - I had issues working on the computer because of some eye problems. I recently got my eyes checked and was diagnosed with astigmatism. Basically, light hits my eyes unevenly, which makes things look blurry. To compensate, I was constantly squinting, which led to tired, strained eyes.

The doctor advised me to limit screen time until I got glasses. Originally, they were supposed to arrive in a week—but lucky me, they came the very next day!

Wearing them feels like I’ve upgraded to 4K vision—seriously, everything is crystal clear. But I’m still adjusting: the new clarity comes with a weird feeling of increased field of view, which is a bit disorienting right now. I also got a blue light filter to help reduce screen-induced eye strain going forward.

Work Update:
Due to the screen time restriction, progress on the next update was minimal—mostly scene prep and groundwork. But now that I’m back in action with my new glasses, I’m resuming full productivity!

Everything should be back to normal now, so I’m getting back to work. Here are a few new renders from the upcoming update!

Once I’m ready, I’ll definitely share the release date with you — but for now, it’s still a bit too early to say! Thank you all for the kind words, both here and on Discord. If you have a moment, as always, I’d really appreciate it if you could leave a review on the game’s Steam page.

Thanks a lot!

notes.title: Bright Lord - Progress update and private message
notes.notes:
[i]A Message from the Heart[/i]

Hey everyone,

I want to start this off with a big note. After the release of the recent update, the reception really demotivated me—not just with Bright Lord, but also with my next project, The Lighthouse. I’ve been struggling to figure out what more I can do. It caught me completely off guard, because I truly felt I had taken my work to the next level.

Thanks to my recent collaboration with FooxiedStudio, I’ve learned so much about what really matters in game development, and how things should be done. When I look back, I know Bright Lord was a mess early on. I made a lot of mistakes simply because I lacked experience. But over these past 13 months, we’ve worked hard to fix everything we could. And here’s what we’ve done so far:

[olist]
[*] Translated the game into six languages
[*] Completely rewrote the first three episodes
[*] Fixed many spelling errors and rewrote dialogue throughout the entire game
[*] Added a new UI and new music
[*] Added achievements
[*] Gave Patreon supporters bonus images as a thank-you
[*] Added around 2000 new renders after the rework was finished
[/olist]

Despite all that, I’ve still received a lot of negativity for reworking and fixing the game. Some people said it was going to be abandoned—but I pushed through, and now we’re here. I know some of the earlier animations weren’t great, and a few were just… bad. I admit it. But I’ve since learned a new program, and in Episodes 11 and 12, the animations are much better (at least in my opinion).

Yes, some of them are short looped animations—but keep in mind, longer animations can take over 24 hours to render. Add in mistakes, bugs, and crashes… and suddenly rendering a batch of animations can take a month. Meanwhile, we’re supposed to be releasing updates during that same time frame. I’ve poured my heart into this game. I’ve invested both my time and money to keep improving it.

I know some ideas may have missed the mark, and some weren’t fully fleshed out. But when you keep learning from your mistakes and the feedback still sounds the same—“Animations are bad,” “Story makes no sense,” “So many grammar mistakes”—it really breaks your spirit. It makes me feel like quitting, because no matter how much I put into this, we end up back at the same point.

And then, out of nowhere, the game gets bombarded with negative reviews on Steam. I’m not saying it’s an organized attack (even though it feels like it sometimes), but it’s crushing to see negative reviews pile up—both on Steam and other sites.

I took a few days off to clear my head, and I realized one thing: I can’t quit. I won’t drop this project. But I am asking you, from the bottom of my heart, to leave an honest review on Steam, so I can figure it out what I can to do better.

It breaks me seeing negative review after negative review. It makes me feel like I have more haters than fans. And while I hate to rant and post something so downbeat, I can’t overstate how important reviews are. They help keep this project afloat. They help me get funding to keep working on the game and improving it for you.

I know it’s probably annoying to hear me asking for reviews again. But this is the sad truth of being a developer: sometimes, we have to beg for them just to get the visibility we need.

Haters tend to be louder than supporters. That’s why I’m asking—if you enjoy what I do, please take one minute to leave a review. It makes a huge difference and gives me the energy to keep pouring hours into this project and giving you my absolute best.

-------

I was pretty frustrated earlier because some people kept complaining about update speed and content size. So, I set a goal to double my efforts this week—and I did just that. Instead of my usual 100 renders, I pushed myself to create 260. This is a new personal record, and I’m proud of the progress.

We’re now about halfway through the renders needed for the next update. If I can keep up this pace next week, we’ll be really close to finishing. My goal is to release the update by the end of the month, and I’m confident that I can have everything ready in the next two weeks if I continue working like this.

I also bought all the parts for my new rig, opting for more premium components, which brought the total to 5,300 euros. Unfortunately, the rendering software doesn’t support the latest GPU line yet—but I’m hopeful that will change soon.

Just to prove I didn’t rush the work this week, here are some more examples. Enjoy!

notes.title: New update just around the corner!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone, [/b]

I’ve got some good news and some not-so-good news. We’ve decided to push the update to March 17th to ensure we don’t rush the animations and can deliver a more polished and fleshed-out experience. This update will feature significantly more detailed animations, including a new ripple effect and an improved boob job that actually feels like one! 😏

I also ran into an issue with Chloe’s scene—I originally wanted her to wear that slim swimsuit throughout the entire sequence, but it was causing so many glitches that I had to remove it to keep the animations smooth. Unfortunately, this meant I had to re-render 40 shots to ensure her swimsuit doesn’t randomly disappear in animations and reappear in still images.

We're almost done with the final renders! I just need today and tomorrow to wrap them up, and then it's time to dive into animations. Since this update features a lot of spicy content, there will be more animations than usual. 

I’m putting a lot of effort into improving animations since they were one of the most critiqued aspects, and I’m excited to keep making them better with every update! Thanks for your patience and support—it’ll be worth it! ❤️

So, that being said - next update date it: 17th March!

notes.title: Bright Lord Plans: Focus, Progress, and Your Feedback
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I just wanted to take a moment to share my thoughts on the journey ahead and what I’ve been working on. It’s been an incredible ride so far, and I’m so grateful for all of your support.

First things first—Bright Lord. My goal is to finish it by mid-2025, and I’m pouring everything I have into making sure it’s the best I can offer. I want it to be something I’m truly proud of, and I want you to feel that same excitement when you play it. I know the road ahead will be challenging, but I’m committed to making it the best I can.

At the moment, I’ve put everything else on hold to focus entirely on Bright Lord. I want the renders, animations, and the story I’m telling to immerse you as much as they do in my head. We’ve reached a point where you can expect plenty of plot twists and intense scenes—basically, everything you’re hoping for.

I don’t want to give an exact date for the next update, but I’m aiming for the end of February or the beginning of March. I hope to make noticeable progress by then.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2906370/Bright_Lord/]In the meantime, I’d love it if you could leave a review if you haven’t already. Your feedback means a lot to me and helps improve the game. Back to work now—talk to you soon![/url]

notes.title: The new update is just seven days away!
notes.notes:
Hey folks!
With only a week left until the release, I’d like to share some details about what you can expect.

EP11 is nearly finished, with around 400 renders completed so far. I’m aiming to add at least 250 more by December 17th and Steam update, depending mostly on whether EP12 will start with a major sex scene or just a filler.

I revisited the main event of EP11 to expand the sex scenes because I know many of you felt they were too short. To make it feel more satisfying, I’ve doubled the render count, and I hope it will have the length and intensity you were looking for.

As for my sleep schedule, it’s still a bit of a mess, but the sleeping pills have been helping me get some rest. I’m focused on delivering a large update as a Christmas gift for all of you. 

I’ve also been focusing a lot on animations since most negative feedback pointed out their simplicity. I’m doing everything I can to improve them, and I hope you’ll notice significant progress with each next update.

This year has been quite busy with the project—refining it, improving the early scenes, and finally adding new ones. I’m hopeful, and pretty confident, that next year will go much smoother. I should be able to release updates more regularly. They’ll likely be smaller but much more frequent, so if you prefer a bigger chunk of content to play, you can always wait for a few updates to stack up.

That’s all for now! I’d also like to ask for a small favor: if you’ve bought the game, please consider leaving a review on Steam. It only takes a few seconds but helps me a lot in getting more visibility, improving the game, and working on future projects. Thank you!

notes.title: Summary of the Release and Future Plans
notes.notes:
[b]Hi everyone![/b]

It’s been two weeks since Bright Lord launched in Early Access on Steam, so it’s a good time to share a quick summary of the project and a few words about our plans and upcoming updates.

I hope you’re enjoying the game’s concept and story so far! We've noticed that the main criticisms focus on the animations and the length of the erotic scenes, so we’re committed to improving these in the future. We also want to give players more influence over the story, making decisions feel more impactful in upcoming updates. On a personal note, I’m really happy with the level of interest in the game, and we’ll do our best to keep it that way while making updates even better.

That said, we’re not slowing down and are already hard at work on the next update. The scripts are ready, all reported bugs have been fixed, and we’re currently working on new renders and animations. I’d say we’re about 25-30% through the next update, so everything is progressing as planned.

Now, for the news you’ve probably been waiting for: [b]the new update will be released on December 17 2024[/b] just a few days before the holidays—less than a month away! It won’t be a very long update, but we prefer smaller, quicker updates rather than bigger ones every six months.

That’s all for now! I’ll keep you updated on our progress. In the meantime, have a great weekend!

[u][i]...if you have read all this, I also ask you to leave a review on Steam, it takes a few seconds and helps me a lot, thank you very much![/i][/u]

notes.title: Bright Lord will be available on November 8!
notes.notes:
Hey!

As I mentioned before, we decided to take the "Bright Lord" game under our wing and enhance it while preserving the story and design created by KissKiss Studio. I’m thrilled to announce that we’ve successfully done it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994738/9696d38f85d1738a05976258bb5241f27f5eae7c.jpg[/img]

On November 8, you’ll be able to get the revamped "Bright Lord" and experience the game in a fresh, updated look. We know many of you have already tried the early access version, so we aimed to keep its core the same while improving its presentation. Here’s what we added:

[list]
[*] A completely new interface
[*] Enhanced renders and animations in the first three episodes (nearly 1,000 new renders)
[*] Improved scripts — the whole game has been proofread
[*] Translation into six more languages: Traditional and Simplified Chinese, Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, French, and Turkish
[*] New wallpapers, bonus renders, and a full DLC pack with over 500 new, exciting shots of each character
[*] Updated sound with new music and SFX
[*] Tons of achievements and collectibles to unlock as you play
[/list]

There are probably even more new features we’ve added that I haven’t listed here. Aside from the updated renders in the first three episodes, the story and renders remain the same, but everything else has been reworked. We can’t wait to release this for you and hear your feedback!

In the meantime, if you haven’t added the game to your wishlist yet, please do so, and have a great weekend.

See you soon!

notes.title: Bright Lord finally has a release date on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

It took us a bit longer than expected, but we’re in the final stages of polishing Bright Lord. As you’ve probably seen on the main page, [b]the Early Access release date is set for November 8th[/b], and no matter what, the game will be in your hands by then. Some of you may have played the demo version, but this one is improved in every way—visual upgrades for the first episodes, fully proofread and revised scripts, a completely new UX/UI, and translations into 7 additional languages besides English.

We’ve also optimized the game’s code, fixed all bugs, and compressed it from 10GB down to 2.5GB without losing any image quality.

This version will include about 75% of the full game, and the final release is planned for 2025. We’re aiming to add six more chapters before the game’s conclusion. Here are a few renders from the game, and we’ll see you in less than a month!

notes.title: Bright Lord - Plans and Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello!

We are excited to introduce our game, Bright Lord, which will be available on Steam in Early Access within the next 2-3 months, with the full version coming in early 2025. Bright Lord has been in development by KissKiss Studio since 2020, and this year, we've teamed up with FooxiedGames, known for Steps of Debauchery, to help us release the game and develop it further.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994738/b865074515abe2f63f43032f02cb89ebc63dcb95.png[/img]

Currently, the game offers about 4-5 hours of gameplay. However, we've faced many challenges, such as changes in writers and programmers, which caused delays and inconsistencies in the story. We are now fixing these issues - the game has undergone a full proofread, the first three episodes are getting graphical improvements, additional content, more story branches, and six more translations. Some of you might have played earlier versions on pirate sites and know what we're talking about. We are working hard to ensure a seamless gaming experience without inconsistent dialogues or errors, and we are confident we will achieve this soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44994738/4f99d61ac56ed16559221b5fd6179174ed7e19b5.png[/img]

Please add the game to your wishlist and share it with others if you can, as it greatly helps us. Thank you so much for your support. I leave you with some new renders - both from reworked episodes 1-3 and from the latest episode 10.
